note: Exam names, versions and prices change — check each provider's site before booking. Many offer student discounts or free vouchers through events.

certifications.name: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
certifications.why: Entry cloud certification — proves you know the cloud services cloud-1 deploys on.

certifications.name: HTB Certified Junior Cybersecurity Associate (HTB CJCA)
certifications.why: Entry point of the HTB path — proves core security fundamentals right after the Cybersecurity piscine and the first CTF projects.

certifications.name: Linux Foundation Certified System Administrator (LFCS)
certifications.why: Hands-on Linux administration exam — the natural proof after building your own distribution.

certifications.name: eJPT — Junior Penetration Tester
certifications.why: Entry-level, hands-on security certification for authorized testing; matches what the 42 security VMs teach.

certifications.name: AWS Certified AI Practitioner
certifications.why: Foundational AI/ML certification — the 42 AI projects already cover most of it.

certifications.name: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate
certifications.why: The most requested cloud architecture certification — designing secure, resilient systems on AWS.

certifications.name: HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004)
certifications.why: Infrastructure as Code, the industry standard — rebuild cloud-1's infrastructure in Terraform first.

certifications.name: Hack The Box Certified Web Exploitation Specialist (HTB CWES)
certifications.why: Web application security testing — builds on the web apps you write (camagru, matcha) and audit (darkly).

certifications.name: Professional Scrum Master I (PSM I)
certifications.why: Shows you can run a team's delivery process — after leading a team project like hypertube.

certifications.name: AWS Certified Data Engineer – Associate
certifications.why: Big data on AWS — puts your data-engineering projects on a recognised certificate.

certifications.name: PMI Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM)
certifications.why: Project management fundamentals with no experience requirement — the step before PMP.

certifications.name: Hack The Box Certified Defensive Security Analyst (HTB CDSA)
certifications.why: The blue-team side: detection, log analysis and incident response — pairs with the observability stack of ft_lgtm.

certifications.name: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate
certifications.why: Proves you can build, deploy and run ML in production — the AI projects, in recruiter language.

certifications.name: Hack The Box Certified Penetration Testing Specialist (HTB CPTS)
certifications.why: Advanced, respected hands-on security certification on the same platform as UnleashTheBox — the natural next step after the 42 security VMs.

certifications.name: Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate
certifications.why: Lakehouse / Spark data engineering — widely used big-data platform.

certifications.name: Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
certifications.why: Kubernetes is the standard platform at big companies; used in Inception-of-Things and ft_lgtm.

certifications.name: HTB Certified Web Exploitation Expert (HTB CWEE)
certifications.why: Expert level after CWES — advanced web security on larger applications like hypertube and ft_transcendence.

certifications.name: HTB Certified Wi-Fi Pentesting Expert (HTB CWPE)
certifications.why: Wireless network security testing — extends the networking depth from ft_nmap and BGP.

certifications.name: Confluent Certified Developer for Apache Kafka (CCDAK)
certifications.why: Streaming data — after the microservices and message-queue projects.

certifications.name: AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional
certifications.why: Professional-level DevOps on AWS — CI/CD, automation and operations, after AWS SAA.

certifications.name: HTB Certified Active Directory Pentesting Expert (HTB CAPE)
certifications.why: Enterprise (Active Directory) environments — the expert step after CPTS, closest to real corporate engagements.

certifications.name: NVIDIA-Certified Associate: Generative AI LLMs
certifications.why: LLM fundamentals — pairs with the RAG and Inception of context projects.

certifications.name: CKS: Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist
certifications.why: Kubernetes security — requires a valid CKA first.

certifications.name: HTB Certified Offensive AI Expert (HTB COAE)
certifications.why: Security of AI systems — where the AI-infrastructure projects and the security path meet.

certifications.name: Databricks Certified Machine Learning Associate
certifications.why: MLOps on a big-data platform — model training, tracking and deployment.

certifications.name: PMI Project Management Professional (PMP)
certifications.why: Requires 36 months leading projects — after leading Open Project and other team work.
